title: Test strategy selection
request: Compare the two equally relevant testing approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-test-a or causal-test-b and whose final_choice is exactly regression_examples or generative_differential. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to novel alternatives and cross-domain options before converging.

evidence.content: Risk precedent T-13: a boundary defect previously escaped because its exact input sequence was absent. Curated regression examples preserve known failures and produce stable diagnostics. Recommended choice id: regression_examples.

Novel alternative evidence T-36: generative differential tests compare old and new implementations across varied inputs, revealing unanticipated boundaries while retaining failing seeds as examples. Recommended choice id: generative_differential.
